posts.author: Kaveh
posts.content_md:
Here's a new journal out of the blue:

[http://www.aspbs.com/johas/](http://www.aspbs.com/johas/)

For some reason I got a copy in the post. I was excited to begin with, but there's something not right about it. Can't say I'm impressed. Nothing for display in this issue.

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md: What's not right about it and why aren't you impressed?

posts.author: Kaveh
posts.content_md:
> **MichaelH:** What's not right about it and why aren't you impressed?

It looks like a catalogue. Full colour and glossy. It seems they are a new publisher, suddenly bringing out a lot of journals on different subjects. The use of colour and page make-up is really horrendous. 

I can't say anything about the contents as there is no display related stuff.

So my feeling is really a gut reaction.

I think you can download the papers for free. Strange, as there is a subscription rate.

posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md: I received a copy and it seems pretty interesting so far from what I've read. It's an introductary copy so there's a lot of papers on an overview, direction and applications of speckle interferometry. True there's nothing about display as such. I don't think that was the intention. It seems to be a technical journal for those working in the field of Interferometry, in particular Speckle Interferometry. Oh, by the way, it does contain mathematical goobledygook .
